s: Din chabit shennishbera ubo h' seipim: chabit shel yayin o shemen shennishbera — gazeru chakamim shello yatztzil mimmenna ella letzorek otah shabbat bilbad, kegon im nishbera belel shabbat qodem akila — matztzil mimmenna leg' seuddot, ubeshacharit lishte seuddot, ubammincha lisudda achat, sheim yihyeh muttar lo lehatztzil harbeh — yesh lachush shemma mechamat tirdat hahatztzala shehu bahul venechpaz lehatztzil — yishkach shehayyom shabbat veyabi kelim derek reshut harabbim lehatztzil bahem mehechabit. Veap akshav sheyyesh omerim sheen lanu reshut harabbim — en lehaqel, ki yesh lachush shemma mechamat shikchat shabbat yabo letaqqen hechabit. Veap im kebar nishbera hechabit legamre venishpak hayyayin laaretz — lo yiqlot min haaretz yoter milletzorek hashshabbat, gezera shemma yispog, dehaynu sheyyasim sepog beyayin hannishpak lachazor ulehattipo bakkeli, vedabar zeh asur middibre soperim, ap im yesh lispog bet achiza sheen lachush bo lischita bi"pesiq resheh" bimqom achizat yado, mikkol maqom maaseh chol hu vezilzul leshabbat. Vegam yesh lachush im yaaseh beshabbat kederek shehu oseh bechol, shemma yabo lischot hassepog bemitkavven, velaken aseru laasot ken ap bemah shemmatztzil letzorek hashshabbat. Veken aseru mittaam zeh letappeach beshemen, dehaynu lehaknis yado beshemen uleqannechah bispat hakkeli, shello yaaseh kederek shehu oseh bechol. Velo aseru lehatztzil yoter mig' seuddot ella bekelim harbeh, abal bikli echad bepaam achat — yakol lehatztzil apillu q' seuddot, shehakkol hatztzala achat hi, kemo shennitbaer besimman shl"d leinyan deleqa. Veyakol lomar laacherim "bou vehatztzilu lakem" kol echad g' seuddot, ap al pi sheyyodea bahem sheyyachaziru lo, kemo shennitbaer sham. Vekol zeh keshennishbera hechabit, shehu bahul venechpaz lehatztzil, abal im nisdeqa vehayyayin oseh tip tip, sheeno bahul kol kak — en lachush sheyyishkach shabbat, umuttar lehatztzil kullo apillu bekelim harbeh. Vekol zeh lehatztzil mechatzer lechatzer, sheyyesh kan torach rab beholakat kelim harbeh, veyesh lachush sheal yede ken yishkach hashshabbat veyabo letaqqen hechabit. Abal lechatzer zo atzmah sheen kan torach kol kak — yakol lehatztzil kemo sheyyirtzeh apillu bekelim harbeh (kemo shennitbaer besimman shl"d sheyyesh meqillin ken gabbe deleqa. Veap sheshsham yesh lehachamir bazeh, mikkol maqom kan yesh lehaqel bezeh, hoil veiqqar gezerat chakamim bezeh hayeta mishshum shemma yabi keli derek reshut harabbim, veakshav yesh omerim sheen lanu reshut harabbim kelal):

Im nishbera berosh gaggo — mebi keli umanniach tachteha, ubilbad shello yabi keli acher veyiqlot leqabbel min haqqilluach baavir leachar sheyyarad min haggag, velo yabi keli acher vitzarep oto lerosh haggag sheyyazub hayyayin min haggag lakkeli, gezera shemma yabi keli derek reshut harabbim. Veim matztzil bikli echad bilbad — matztzil apillu qolet o metzarep, shekkevan shello hittiru lo ella keli echad — en lachush sheyyishkach hashshabbat veyabi keli derek reshut harabbim:

Nizdammenu lo orechim — mebi keli acher veqolet, keli acher umetzarep. Velo yiqlot vitzarep veachar kak yazmin haorechim, ella mazminam techilla. Velo yaarim lezammen orechim sheenam tzerikim leekol velishtot kede sheyyotiru lo. Veim abar veasa sheqqalat vetzerep veachar kak hizmin orechim (vaapillu orechim sheenam tzerikim leekol velishtot) — muttar:

Im yazub tirosh missedeq shebbegigit shel anabim sheadayin lo nidreku, shennimtza oto haddelep eno rauy beshabbat, shehare hammashqin shezzabu beshabbat asurim, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"k, veeno rashshay lasum keli tachtayv mippene shemmebattelo mehekano, ketzad yaaseh? Yanniach sham mittato o shulchano veyiqba sham yeshibato, veaz yihyeh oto haddelep lepanayv kigrap shel rei, mippene shemmelaklek et haqqarqa veoseh tit, veyukal lehanniach sham keli leqabbel lehaddelep kede shello yaaseh tit. Veen kan bittul keli mehekano, mippene shekkesheyyitmalle hakkeli yukal letaltelo leshopko ulehachaziro tachat haddelep leqabbelo kede shello yaaseh tit. Veen bezeh mishshum issur tiltul, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"ch bekol gerap shel rei, shehittiru bo hattiltul mippene kebodo shel adam. Veap sheen osin gerap shel rei lekattechilla, mikkol maqom mishshum hepsed hittiru, kemo shennitbaer sham. Ukesheyyitmalle hakkeli — lo yishpekennu likli acher, shello yebattelennu mehekano, ella meriqo betok haggigit shezzabu hammashqim mimmenna, shehi mebuttelet kebar mehekanah al yede mashqin shebbah haasurim mishshum shezzabu beshabbat. Veim hu rotzeh — yakol litten keli im mayim tachat yayin haddolep, kede sheyyitbattel hayyayin bemayim rishon rishon, veaz muttar letaltel hakkeli uleshopko ulehachaziro beli sheyyiqba sham yeshibato. Veap sheachar kak mitrabbeh hayyayin al hammayim — en lachush, lepi sheyyesh meqillin bezeh apillu leinyan yen nesek, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea simman ql"d, veyesh lismok al dibrehem al kol panim leinyan tiltul. Veap sheyyayin zeh hu "dabar sheyyesh lo mattirin" — ap al pi ken hu mitbattel bemayim, shello ameru "dabar sheyyesh lo mattirin" eno batel ella keshennitareb min bemino, abal lo besheeno mino, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea simman q"b:

Nitpazzero lo perot bechatzer achat henna veachat henna — melaqqet meat meat veokel. Velo yitten letok hassal velo letok haqquppa, shello yaaseh kederek shehu oseh bechol. Abal im napelu bemaqom echad — noten apillu letok hassal vehaqquppa. Ella im ken napelu letok tzerorot veaprurit shebbechatzer, sheaz melaqqet echad echad veokel, velo yitten letok hassal velo letok haqquppa, shello yaaseh kederek shehu oseh bechol:
